name: activity-terrain
title: Activity Terrain
description: A contribution heatmap inside a rounded card that lifts each day into a bar, forming a tilted 3D terrain. A Flat and Terrain switch swaps views, hovering a day bumps and highlights it, and dragging turns the model.
use: A profile or dashboard should show a year of daily activity and invites people to explore it in 3D.
avoid: The 3D view needs drag and a wide card, and dense months are hard to compare as heights.
a11y: Arrow keys read days and the switch is focusable, but rotating the terrain has no keyboard control. (keyboard: partial, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A rounded dark card with a small title, a contribution total and a two-part Flat and Terrain switch at the top right. Below, a dense grid of grey columns stands on a black plane, the tallest almost white, with a Less-to-More legend at the bottom.
behaves: On first view the grid tilts up from flat and swings into a three-quarter angle. Dragging rotates and pitches the terrain, a flick coasts and springs back, hovering pops a column to reveal its date, and the switch flattens the grid into a heatmap.
customise: Props supply the daily count array, end date, title and whether it starts flat; the 3D maths, tilt limits, springs and palette variables need a source edit.
weight: moderate: Sorts and paints roughly 180 columns on a canvas only while tilting or dragged.
demo: Reads 402 contributions in the last 26 weeks, with generated daily counts behind it.
issues: The terrain view fades out the month and weekday labels, so only the hover readout gives a date.
polishWhy: Neat 3D rendering and springy drag; tiny columns and lost labels cost clarity.
